rulesEnglishNote: The technical rule descriptions below are shown in English for transparency of the explainability trace.

narrative.mood: mood-related concerns in your screening responses
narrative.anxiety: anxiety-related concerns in your screening responses

suggestion.mood: Repeat a check-in when it suits you
suggestion.noteTalk: A supportive conversation while you decide on the next step.
suggestion.noteBreathe: Keep the small habits that are working.
suggestion.noteMood: A weekly rhythm is plenty for lower-range results.
suggestion.noteTalkSupportive: Talk through what is driving these feelings.
suggestion.noteBreatheGrounding: Short daily practice can lower the background noise.
suggestion.noteMoodSooner: Re-check in a few days to see which direction things are moving.
suggestion.noteProfessionalConsider: A qualified person can confirm what these results mean.
suggestion.noteProfessionalContact: The Department of Psychiatry at DSU can guide you.
suggestion.noteTalkNow: You do not have to carry this alone while you arrange support.
suggestion.noteBreatheGentle: Something small to steady the next hour.
